title: AI Gate and executeMove
description: The React state that decides whether any provider is ready, and the move handler that calls the model only when it is.

steps.description: `aiEnabled` is true when the selected provider has the fields it needs: an Anthropic key, an OpenAI key, or an Open WebUI URL and model. The comment asks whether any provider is actually ready to use.
Inside `executeMove`, after the move is already applied and drawn, check `currentAIEnabled` and turn on the commentary loading flag.
Run the two calls together with `Promise.all`, then store the commentary and the Elo estimate.
The `catch` turns a failed request into a visible message instead of a silent one, and the `finally` always clears the loading flag.
When AI is not enabled, set the commentary to tell the player to configure a provider. The page says this fallback keeps the app usable with no provider at all.
